## Row

### From awareness to a reservation

**From awareness to a reservation**

The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch CEP connects newsletter design, guest experience, social media, and website usability to a more accessible guest journey. **My contribution is AO4: website content, navigation, and usability.**

This dashboard summarizes the documented research plan. The counts above describe objectives and planned tasks, not measured performance. The 80% target is a proposed project benchmark, not a published usability standard.

[Home](index.qmd) · [Project listings](listings.qmd) · [Download objectives](data/cep-objectives.csv)

# Website usability

## Row

### Three tasks, one transparent target

**Three tasks, one transparent target**

```{r}
#| label: fig-targets
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-alt: "Three planned website usability tasks, each with a proposed 80 percent unassisted completion target. These are targets, not observed rates."
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(tasks, aes(x = benchmark_pct, y = reorder(task, -seq_along(task)))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#164a46", width = .5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(benchmark_pct, "% target")), hjust = -0.07, size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(x = "Proposed unassisted completion target (%)", y = NULL,
       caption = "Planning values only. No participant performance is plotted.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
```

### Evidence collection

**Evidence collection**

The planned usability study measures unassisted success, elapsed seconds, ease ratings (1–5), device type, and navigation barriers for each task. Analysis uses de-identified participant records.

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(observations) == 0) {
  cat("**Observed results: not yet available in this portfolio.** No participant observations were supplied. Completion rates, median times, and ease ratings cannot yet be reported.")
}
```

[Download the observation template](data/usability-observations-template.csv)

## Row

### How results will inform decisions

**How results will inform decisions**

| Measure | Calculation | Decision supported |
|---|---|---|
| Unassisted completion | Successful unassisted attempts / valid attempts × 100 | Identify tasks below the proposed 80% target |
| Median successful time | Median seconds among successful unassisted attempts | Identify tasks that remain slow even when successful |
| Ease of use | Distribution of valid 1–5 ratings per task | Locate perceived friction |
| Qualitative barriers | Code recurring notes by task | Prioritize specific label, content, or placement changes |

Results will include denominators and missing-value counts. A task with no valid attempts receives **NA**, not 0%. Small samples and device differences limit generalization. Reaching the reservation interface is not a completed reservation or evidence of revenue growth.

### Source & reproducibility

**Source & reproducibility**

Planning source: Group 9, *A Filling Recipe for Open Tables at Kellogg Ranch*, October 17, 2026 version. AO4 is attributed to Georgia Monjarrez in that report. The CSV files summarize the objectives and task definitions; no participant records are included.

The value boxes, table, and target chart are generated from local CSV files by R during rendering. Quarto produces a static HTML dashboard that can be hosted on GitHub Pages without an R server.
